cards.meaning: stand, conviction; firm position held under pressure
cards.example: Ipinakita ng prosekusyon ang kanilang paninindigan na ituloy ang kaso.
cards.exampleMeaning: The prosecution showed their resolve to pursue the case.
cards.note: Pormal ngunit gamit sa pulitika at balita; galing sa 'tindig.' Iba sa 'opinyon' na puwedeng magbago agad.
cards.tiesTo: Prosecution's stand after Trillanes was dropped as a witness

cards.example: Ang pag-atras ng testigo ay nagbigay ng bagong tanong sa paglilitis.
cards.exampleMeaning: The witness's withdrawal raised new questions at the trial.
cards.note: May kaunting hiya o kaba; iba sa 'pagbitiw' na mas pormal at tungkol sa puwesto.
cards.tiesTo: Trillanes' withdrawal as a witness in the Sara Duterte trial

cards.example: 这项政策不但降低了贷款成本，而且提振了购房者的信心。
cards.examplePinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè bú dàn jiàngdī le dàikuǎn chéngběn, érqiě tízhèn le gòufángzhě de xìnxīn.
cards.exampleMeaning: This policy not only lowered borrowing costs but also lifted homebuyers' confidence.
cards.note: Slightly more spoken than 不仅…而且 (more written/formal). If the two clauses have different subjects, 不但 goes before the first subject. The second clause carries the heavier weight.
cards.tiesTo: Beijing's Golden Week property promotions and mortgage subsidy

cards.meaning: promotion, promotional sale; to promote sales
cards.example: 开发商大力促销，希望吸引更多买家。
cards.examplePinyin: Kāifāshāng dàlì cùxiāo, xīwàng xīyǐn gèng duō mǎijiā.
cards.exampleMeaning: Developers are promoting heavily, hoping to attract more buyers.
cards.note: Neutral-commercial register. Broader than 打折 (a price cut): 促销 covers coupons, gifts and bundles. Collocations: 搞促销, 促销活动, 促销价, 大力促销.
cards.tiesTo: Property promotions in 130+ cities during Golden Week
